'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Middle Eastern crisis (2023–present)|Middle Eastern crisis]]
**[[2026 Iran war]]
***[[2026 Strait of Hormuz crisis]]
****[[2026 United States naval blockade of Iran]]
*****The [[United States Central Command]] (CENTCOM) says it has redirected 12 commercial vessels and disabled one since the naval [[blockade]] on [[Iran]] resumed on July 14. [https://www.middleeasteye.net/live-blog/live-blog-update/centcom-says-it-has-redirected-12-commercial-vessels (''Middle East Eye'')]
****The [[Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps Navy]] says it has stopped three [[oil tanker|oil tankers]] from passing through the [[Strait of Hormuz]]. [https://www.arabnews.com/node/2651952/middle-east (AFP via ''Arab News'')]
***[[July 2026 United States strikes against Iran]]
****The [[Islamic Republic News Agency]] reports that the [[United States Armed Forces|U.S. military]] struck the [[Shalamcheh]] area near the [[Iran–Iraq border]]. Two people are reported to be killed and 11 are reported injured. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/live/2026/jul/23/us-iran-war-live-updates-strikes-houthis-red-sea-saudi-nuclear-deal-middle-east-crisis-latest-news?CMP=share_btn_url&page=with%3Ablock-6a615f5d8f088134984ca632#block-6a615f5d8f088134984ca632 (''The Guardian'')] [https://www.middleeasteye.net/live-blog/live-blog-update/us-strike-irans-border-iraq-kills-two (''Middle East Eye'')]
****The U.S. CENTCOM reports on [[X (social network)|X]] that they have conducted strikes against Iran for a 13th consecutive night amidst clashes over shipping routes, with explosions reported in [[Ahvaz]], [[Bandar Abbas]], and [[Qeshm Island]]. [https://www.newarab.com/news/us-launches-13th-night-strikes-iran-war-escalates (MENA via ''The New Arab'')] [https://abc7chicago.com/story/us-military-says-launching-strikes-iran-clashes-escalate-shipping-routes/19565269/ (WLS-TV)]
***[[Kuwait in the 2026 Iran war]]
****[[Kuwait]]'s [[Ministry of Defense (Kuwait)|defense ministry]] reports that a drone has hit the [[Abdali, Al Jahra|Abdali]] area near the [[Iraq–Kuwait border|Iraqi border]]. [https://www.arabtimesonline.com/news/kuwaits-abdali-border-crossing-attacked-for-the-second-time-by-drone-no-casualties/ (KUNA via ''Arab Times Kuwait'')] [https://www.kurdistan24.net/en/story/927749/hostile-drone-hits-kuwaits-abdali-border-crossing-amid-ongoing-iran-us-conflict (Kurdistan24)]
**[[Red Sea crisis]]
***The [[Houthis]] claim to have attacked two [[Saudi Arabia]]n oil tankers in the [[Red Sea]] for their violation of the blockade by [[Yemen]]'s Houthi-led [[Yemeni Armed Forces|armed forces]]. There are no reported casualties. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/7/22/yemens-houthis-claim-attack-on-two-saudi-oil-tankers (Al Jazeera)]
***Shipping data shows that two [[China|Chinese]] [[Oil tanker#Size categories|very-large crude carriers]] carrying four million [[Barrel (unit)#Oil barrel|​barrels]] of [[Oil reserves in Saudi Arabia|Saudi Arabian oil]], the [[Singapore|Singaporean]]-[[Flag state|flagged]] ''VLCC Xin Long Yang'' and Chinese-flagged ''VLCC Cosnew Lake'', are heading towards [[Bab-el-Mandeb]] strait. [https://www.reuters.com/business/energy/two-chinese-supertankers-with-saudi-oil-head-bab-el-mandeb-red-sea-exit-2026-07-23/ (Reuters)]
***[[Germany]]'s [[Federal Ministry of Defence (Germany)|defence ministry]] moves the [[Frankenthal-class minehunter|''Frankenthal''-class minehunter]] ''Fulda'' and the [[replenishment oiler]] [[German ship Mosel|''Mosel'']] from the coast of [[Djibouti]] to the eastern [[Mediterranean Sea]], citing uncertainty over a planned Strait of Hormuz mission and concerns about prolonged deployment affecting the vessels. [https://english.alarabiya.net/amp/News/middle-east/2026/07/23/german-military-to-withdraw-two-vessels-from-red-sea-defense-ministry (AFP via Al Arabiya)]
***[[Reuters]] reports that Iran sent [[Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps]] officers, along with [[unmanned aerial vehicles in the Iranian military|drone]]- and [[Ballistic missile program of Iran|missile]]-related equipment, on a [[Mahan Air]] flight to [[Houthi-controlled Yemen]] on July 13, in preparation for the blockade on Saudi Arabia. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/iran-flew-irgc-commanders-missile-gear-yemens-houthis-sources-say-2026-07-23/ (Reuters)]
*[[Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|Sudanese civil war]]
**[[2026 Blue Nile campaign]]
***Emergency lawyers report that a [[drone strike]] has killed several civilians in the Badia area of [[Sudan]]'s [[Blue Nile State]]. [https://sudantribune.com/article/316532 (''Sudan Tribune'')]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Economic impact of the 2026 Iran war]]
**[[2026 Iran war fuel crisis]]
***[[Oil prices]], including [[Brent Crude]] and [[West Texas Intermediate]], increase to over [[United States dollar|US$]]101 per [[Barrel (volume)|barrel]] and to nearly $93 per barrel, respectively, after the escalation in the Red Sea. The [[Petroleum in the United States|United States gasoline]] national average increases to $4.09 per [[gallon]]. [https://www.nbcnews.com/business/markets/oil-prices-rise-red-sea-attacks-houthis-saudi-trump-iran-war-rcna588851 (NBC News)]
*[[Foie gras controversy]]
**[[Brazil]]ian [[President of Brazil|president]] [[Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva]] signs a [[Law of Brazil|law]] banning the production and sale of ''[[foie gras]]'', citing [[Animal welfare and rights in Brazil|animal cruelty]]. The measure effectively ends [[Economy of Brazil|Brazilian imports]] of the product. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/brazils-lula-signs-into-law-foie-gras-ban-angering-france-2026-07-24/ (Reuters)]
*[[Tariffs in the second Trump administration]]
**The [[United States]] imposes [[tariff]]s of 10% to 12.5% on [[List of imports of the United States|imports]] from 60 [[Foreign trade of the United States|trading partners]], citing [[Forced labour|forced-labor]] concerns. The [[Duty (tax)|duties]] take effect Friday and exempt [[USMCA]]-covered goods and products already subject to [[2025–2026 United States trade war with Canada and Mexico|sector-specific tariffs]]. [https://business.inquirer.net/601966/us-unveils-new-tariffs-on-60-partners-as-trump-rebuilds-trade-agenda (AFP via ''Philippine Daily Inquirer'')]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2026 France wildfires]]
**More than 20,000 people are [[Emergency evacuation|evacuated]] from their homes as [[wildfire]]s spread in [[Gironde]], [[France]]. More than 700 [[firefighter]]s have been deployed to battle the fires. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cy4kmr82n44o (BBC News)] 

'''Health and environment'''
*[[2026 United States cyclosporiasis outbreak]]
**[[Taylor Farms]] temporarily suspend operations at its processing facility in [[Mexican Plateau|central]] [[Mexico]] after [[United States Department of Health and Human Services|American health officials]] linked it to a current [[cyclosporiasis]] outbreak in the [[U.S.]], which is caused by ''[[Cyclospora cayetanensis]]''. [https://www.reuters.com/business/healthcare-pharmaceuticals/michigan-reports-7644-cyclosporiasis-cases-ongoing-outbreak-2026-07-23/ (Reuters)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2025 shootings of Minnesota legislators]]
**[[United States federal judge]] [[John R. Tunheim]] sentences [[Vance Boelter]] to two [[Life imprisonment in the United States|life terms]] plus 40 years without [[parole]] for killing [[Minnesota]] [[Minnesota House of Representatives|state representative]] [[Melissa Hortman]] and her husband and wounding [[Minnesota Senate|state senator]] [[John Hoffman (Minnesota politician)|John Hoffman]] and his wife in June 2025. [https://www.manilatimes.net/2026/07/24/world/life-in-prison-for-minnesota-man-who-killed-state-lawmaker/2390656 (AFP via ''The Manila Times'')]
*[[International Criminal Court investigation in Darfur]]
**The [[International Criminal Court]] at [[The Hague]], [[Netherlands]], officially drops charges against former militia leader [[Abdallah Banda]], who was previously charged for his role in a [[Raids on Haskanita|2007 attack]] on [[African Union]] peacekeepers during [[Sudan]]'s [[War in Darfur|Darfur conflict]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/international-criminal-court-drops-case-against-darfur-militia-leader-2026-07-23/ (Reuters)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[Reactions to the 2026 Iran war]]
**The [[United States House of Representatives]] votes 214–208 to approve [[War Powers Resolution|war powers]] legislation attempting to require the [[president of the United States]] to halt military action against Iran. The [[United States Senate]] votes 47–49 to stop the legislation from advancing. [https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/23/congress-pushes-war-powers-resolutions-tells-trump-to-abandon-iran-war.html (CNBC)] [https://www.reuters.com/legal/government/us-house-votes-halt-iran-war-another-symbolic-rebuke-trump-2026-07-23/ (Reuters)]

'''Science and technology'''
*The [[International Mathematical Union]] awards the 2026 [[Fields Medal]]s to [[Yu Deng]], [[John Pardon]], [[Jacob Tsimerman]], and [[Hong Wang]] at the [[International Congress of Mathematicians]] in [[Philadelphia]], [[Pennsylvania]], [[United States]]. Wang becomes the third woman to receive the prize after [[Maryam Mirzakhani]] in 2014 and [[Maryna Viazovska]] in 2022. [https://www.lemonde.fr/en/international/article/2026/07/23/fields-medal-awarded-to-four-young-mathematicians_6755774_4.html (AFP via ''Le Monde'')]
